Manuelita produces cane sugar and its derivatives across four business platforms: sugar cane, oil palm, aquaculture and fruit and vegetables [U1][U12]. Its own production list includes cane, sugar, bioethanol, palm oil, palm kernel oil, biodiesel, table grapes, shrimp and mussels [U1][U3]. It also makes refined glycerin [U2][U8] and generates energy [U8]. Bioethanol has been made from sugar cane since 2006 and biodiesel from palm oil since 2009, which makes it the first producer of advanced biofuels in Colombia from two biomass sources [U5]. Its shrimp is marketed for export (whole, raw and cooked) to markets in Europe and Asia [U8].
